comparator.sourceNotes: Exact target is VU full-time Bachelor Psychologie, CROHO56604, registry language NLD. Controlling Dutch OER2026–27, adopted28May2026, applies to all enrolled students from1September2026 (A1.1); it is an annual complete curriculum, not a promise of unchanged future editions. Dutch instruction under10.4; PHP year3 courses are explicitly English within the Dutch route. Article11.3 establishes60EC compulsory Year1 and48EC compulsory Year2;11.4.1 requires one connected12EC preminor;11.4.2 requires a30EC Year3 pathway, including12EC thesis;12.1 preserves30EC free elective space in Year3 semester1. Total25credit-bearing components180EC. Threepreminors: Behaviour and the Brain; Emotie,Cognitie en Gedrag; Leadership,Power and Social Influence. First-listed connectedpair Behaviour and the Brain (Addiction6,CognitiveNeuroscience6) is retained by neutral officialOER order, independently of UCR. PHP retained as least-specialised/general pathway because the current Dutch prospectus expressly frames it as broad origins, prevention and reduction of mental-health problems, rather than therapist preparation, organisational application, or genetics/neuroscience specialisation. This is a documented judgment, not an official rank of breadth. OER and current NL guide independently confirm allfourpathways; source accessibility is removed as a selection reason. First-listed suggested PHP elective Cognition and Emotion6 is retained by OER order; API alphabetic ordering does not replace curricular order. PHP compulsory LowIntensityTreatments6,Statistics3 6,B-thesis12, plusone6ECelective=30. Article11.4 normally combines a track minor and same-track semester2 but explicitly permits another minor/complete other track semester2 and one B3PSY substitution when same-track. Article12.1 permits a programmedminor or freely chosen courses (at least12EClevel300), requiring approval;12.2 exempts specified university/psychology minors from priorapproval subjectentryconditions. A free minor requires coherence,atleasttwolevel300units,maxonelevel100,nooverlap,priorboardapproval. Psychology and the Brain minor is barred. Open30EC is preserved; the five PHP minor courses are possible choices, not compulsory for this pathway. No arbitrary minor content is invented. Article9.1: thesis requires allYear1components; Proefpersoonschap0EC is prerequisite to recording PsychologicalConversationSkills1. Article10.4: Dutch diagnosticlanguage test at entry; failedtest requires remedialcourse; IntroPsychology grade withheld untiltest/remediationcomplete. Article11.5:80%practicalattendance; repeatattendance exceptions exclude namedconversation-skills courses; board maygrantjustifiedexemptions. Article14:positiveBSArequires42ECYear1 byendfirstenrolmentyear;negativeBSA barsPsychology fornext3years,subjectfacultypersonal-circumstances process. A3.1 requirescourse/examregistration. Currentcatalogue also lists EnglishLanguageTest0EC alongside NLtest in sharedYear1 group; DutchOER controls language obligation, so dualtests are not invented. Optionalhonours is excluded. Actualcoursepages confirm Methods2 is empiricalteamresearch with regression,power,AI/open-science/ethics,not a qualitative-methods course; Stats2 is regression/ANOVA/ANCOVA; Measurement2 is psychometrics includingvalidity/bias/item-response; LowIntensityTreatments includespractisedpsychoeducation,behaviouralactivation,cognitiverestructuring anddigitaldelivery. Methods2 stronglyrecommendspriorStats2attendance but expresslydoesnotrequirepassedStats2. Course-specificworkgroup/passconditionsapply. OERprintedcodes P_BIOCOG/P_BPERSON differfromcatalogue P_BBIOCOG/P_BPEROND; identicaltitles/EC andannualguide resolve identity using currentcataloguecodes. CurrentBigData codeP_BBDPSY anddevelopmentcodeP_BOWPPSY replace theEnglishTER-basedoldcodes. Visually inspectedPDFpp16–19 agreewithtext,includingmisalignedPHPtablecodecolumns; currentNLcataloguegroupPB3_TR_CLIN independentlyresolves PHP24+6. No material hiddeneditionconflict; visibleheaders2026–27 andadoptiondate28May2026 agree. StaleNLguideparagraph says threepathways while listingfour; DutchOER11.4 andcurrentprospectus explicitlyfour control.

questionsApplications.label: Prospective-student illustrations include social-media choices, anxiety/trauma and health-behaviour relapse; older phone-checking and ADHD examples are historical leads not repeated as currently corroborated claims. Examples do not generate programmes.

Further-study and employment possibilities include clinical/developmental and cognitive research, organisational work, communication, health policy, research assistance and coaching. These are search-only trajectories, not guaranteed admission or qualifications. The older exact UX/market-research job list is not repeated on the current future page.

alternatives.concept: A psychology-centred response studies mental disorders, clinical assessment and psychotherapy, health and illness, and development across the lifespan. Brain and cognitive science add biological perspectives; epidemiology, pharmacology and research methods support critical study of health evidence. A youth-resilience project provides one specific prevention application. This offers substantial related psychology without reproducing VU’s psychometric sequence, behavioural genetics, practised low-intensity treatment protocols, professional interviewing or individual thesis.

alternatives.labelRationale: Eight psychology courses (60 EC) include social and abnormal psychology, clinical assessment and psychotherapy, medical and health psychology, lifespan development, research synthesis, statistics and youth resilience. The brain/behaviour gateway and three cognitive courses add 30 EC of neuroscience; epidemiology and pharmacology add 15 EC of health study. Methods, philosophy, sociology, communication and PPD complete the programme. Each whole 7.5-EC course was reviewed; no complete clinical-training claim is made.

alternatives.concept: A related direction studies social behaviour, workplace motivation and leadership, decision-making, and persuasive communication. Organisational psychology and behavioural economics extend the shared psychology and research foundation; media analysis examines representation and whose stories shape social understanding. This changes the academic emphasis toward organisations and public influence. It does not reproduce a full organisational-psychology major, specialist personnel assessment, human-resource training or a track-specific thesis.

comparisonAlignment.rationale: Professional psychological conversation skills have no sufficiently direct counterpart in rhetoric or general presentation.
Advanced professional interviewing/listening is not reproduced by persuasion or qualitative research.
Both introduce psychological theories and brain–behaviour questions; the gateway is narrower than VU’s general introduction.
Shared scientific study of social influences on thought, feeling and behaviour; scope and EC differ.
Lifespan development directly addresses the developmental part of this integrated development/psychopathology unit; disorder depth differs.
Development and organisational courses discuss personality in context; no scheduled course provides the dedicated personality-theory/research unit.
Neurobiology directly addresses the biological-neuroscience part; it does not reproduce the integrated cognitive/biological unit in full.
Sensory/perceptual and action mechanisms are an identifiable neuropsychological subdomain; clinical assessment/lesion breadth is narrower.
Emotion, attention, decisions and higher-order cognitive processes overlap directly with Cognition and Emotion; exact scope and assessment differ.
The selected Addiction unit has no sufficiently specific scheduled counterpart.
The broad cognitive-neuroscience courses are already assigned to their strongest components; no additional full preminor course is inferred.
Molecular biology and lifespan environmental influences do not establish behavioural-genetic interaction methods.
Study design, sampling, experiments/surveys and a research project provide a direct introductory research-method relationship; not identical disciplinary coverage.
Both explicitly teach regression and ANOVA/ANCOVA, applications and reporting. The UCR course also covers other multivariate techniques.
Data cleaning, manipulation and analysis are an important shared data-method function; psychological applications and scale differ.
Introductory statistics contributes within the UCR methods course already paired above; no second standalone UCR statistics unit is assigned here.
VU combines empirical team research, regression/power, AI literacy, open science and ethics. Qualitative methods or research synthesis do not establish that complete method sequence.
No dedicated psychometric measurement course is scheduled.
Factor analysis as a general statistical method and clinical assessment do not establish test validity/bias/item-response psychometrics.
Machine learning and meta-analysis contribute methods but no sufficiently specific track-statistics counterpart is established.
A 12-EC individual thesis is required after all Year1 units. Optional UCR independent research is additional to the scheduled180EC; it does not certify equivalent assessment.
Philosophy of mind directly examines mind/body, consciousness and identity; VU’s broader philosophy/psychology framing is not reproduced in full.
Both study motivation, leadership, groups and organisational behaviour; the UCR course is not a complete organisational-psychology major.
Psychotherapeutic approaches and clinical interventions are important shared subject matter. UCR does not establish VU’s practised low-intensity protocols, digital delivery or treatment fidelity.
A genuine approved30ECchoice; no selected minor content or UCR course equivalence is presumed.

notes.text: UCR offers substantial psychology, cognition and research methods. It does not reproduce VU’s psychometric measurement sequence, behavioural genetics, dedicated personality course, professional interviewing, practised low-intensity treatment protocols or individual thesis. Clinical assessment and general statistics provide partial contributions rather than those complete sequences.

The organisational alternative adds organisational psychology, behavioural economics, persuasion and critical media analysis. These form a related direction; they do not reproduce VU’s complete organisational-psychology pathway, specialist personnel assessment or thesis. The media course studies representation and social history rather than experimentally measuring social-media influence.

The Dutch curriculum contains 108 EC of compulsory study in years one and two, a connected 12 EC preminor, 30 EC of approved minor or elective study, and 30 EC in a final-year pathway. Research participation and the Dutch language test or remediation are separate obligations; the thesis requires all first-year units. Optional UCR independent research is additional to the scheduled 180 EC.

audience.programmeDescription: VU Psychology studies thought, emotion and behaviour through biological, cognitive, social, developmental and clinical perspectives. The first two years include research methods, statistics, measurement and professional conversation skills. The Dutch curriculum allows a final-year pathway and approved minor or elective study.
audience.comparisonExplanation: Two UCR alternatives offer related psychology through a broader liberal-arts curriculum. The first emphasises psychopathology, development and health; the second adds organisations, decision-making and public influence. Specialist measurement, interviewing, treatment practice and research requirements differ from VU.

curriculum.limitation: This 180-EC Dutch-track pathway retains 30 EC of approved minor or elective study. The Psychopathology, Health and Prevention final-year pathway is taught in English. Research participation, the Dutch diagnostic language test or remediation, attendance and registration conditions apply. Positive first-year advice requires 42 EC; the thesis requires all first-year units. Future annual regulations may change.
